sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尔尼西，欢迎收听《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Last week, we told the story of Golan, a father of four whose kibbutz was attacked by Hamas terrorists.
sentences.zh: 上周，我们讲述了戈兰的故事，他有四个孩子，他的基布兹遭到哈马斯恐怖分子的袭击。

sentences.en: It was an attack that killed 1,300 Israelis and prompted Israel's government to say it will now destroy Hamas, which governs Gaza and its two million residents.
sentences.zh: 那场袭击造成1300名以色列人死亡，并促使以色列政府表示，它现在将摧毁统治加沙及其两百万居民的哈马斯。

sentences.en: Now, we turn to what's happened inside Gaza in the days since that attack.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们将目光转向自那次袭击发生几天来加沙内部发生的事情。

sentences.en: Israel has prohibited food, water, and electricity from entering the territory and has bombarded it with airstrikes that have killed more than 2,600 Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 以色列禁止食品、水和电力进入该领土，并对其进行了空袭，轰炸造成两千六百多名巴勒斯坦人死亡。

sentences.en: Late last week, the situation grew more dire when Israel ordered people in the north of Gaza,
sentences.zh: 上周晚些时候，当以色列命令加沙北部的人民时，局势变得更加严峻，

sentences.en: nearly half the population, to evacuate to the south ahead of an expected Israeli ground invasion.
sentences.zh: 在预计以色列将发动地面进攻之前，近一半的人口向南撤离。

sentences.en: Many in Gaza now fear that this mass expulsion will become permanent, reopening the trauma of Israel's creation in 1948, which displaced more than 700,000 Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 加沙的许多人现在担心这种大规模驱逐将变成永久性的，重新开启1948年以色列建国带来的创伤，当时有七十多万巴勒斯坦人流离失所。

sentences.en: Today, conversations with two people in Gaza about what they've experienced so far and what they expect comes next.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们与加沙的两个人进行了对话，谈谈他们迄今为止的经历以及他们对接下来会发生什么的预期。

sentences.en: It's Monday, October 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月16日，星期一。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi, is this Abdullah?
sentences.zh: 喂，请问是阿卜杜拉吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Hi, Abdullah.
sentences.zh: 嗨，阿卜杜拉。

sentences.en: My name is Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我叫萨布丽娜·塔韦尔尼西。

sentences.en: I spoke to Abdullah Hassanin on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我在星期四跟阿卜杜拉·哈萨宁交谈过。

sentences.en: He's 23 years old and lives in southern Gaza in a town called Rafa.
sentences.zh: 他23岁，住在加沙南部的拉法镇。

sentences.en: At that point, people there had endured six straight days of airstrikes.
sentences.zh: 当时，那里的人们已经忍受了连续六天的空袭。

sentences.en: Basically, I don't know if I'm going to be alive for the next hours or no.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我不知道接下来几个小时我是否还能活着。

sentences.en: My neighbors who are living just two blocks away from my house are evacuating at this moment
sentences.zh: 我的邻居就住在离我家两个街区的地方，他们此刻正在撤离，

sentences.en: as they have received a threat that their whole building is going to be bombed within a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 因为他们收到威胁说，他们的整栋大楼将在几分钟内遭到轰炸。

sentences.en: So basically, it's a three-story building or a four-story building.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，这是一栋三层或四层的建筑。

sentences.en: But when one building is threatened to be bombed, the whole block has to evacuate because it's a mass destruction to the whole area.
sentences.zh: 但是当一栋建筑受到轰炸威胁时，整个街区都必须撤离，因为这对整个地区来说是毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: So the whole block that is next to my home is evacuating at this moment as I am talking to you.
sentences.zh: 所以就在我跟你说话的时候，我家隔壁的整个街区正在撤离。

sentences.en: The whole block next to your home is being evacuated right now.
sentences.zh: 你家隔壁的整个街区现在正在撤离。

sentences.en: Are you seeing that out your window?
sentences.zh: 你从窗户能看到吗？

sentences.en: I'm just seeing people running.
sentences.zh: 我只看到人们在奔跑。

sentences.en: And actually, there's no light as the electricity is cut off since yesterday.
sentences.zh: 事实上，没有光，因为从昨天开始电力就中断了。

sentences.en: And I have already been facing difficulty just connecting to a stable internet connection to make this call with you.
sentences.zh: 我甚至很难连接到稳定的互联网来跟你通这个电话。

sentences.en: Where in the house am I reaching you right now?
sentences.zh: 我现在联系你时，你在屋里的什么地方？

sentences.en: Where is safest?
sentences.zh: 哪里最安全？

sentences.en: I don't know where safeSt.
sentences.zh: 我不知道哪里安全。

sentences.en: There's no safeSt.
sentences.zh: 没有安全的地方。

sentences.en: I'm just standing here in the balcony just to make this call.
sentences.zh: 我只是站在这里的阳台上打这通电话。

sentences.en: No place is safe enough in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 在加沙，没有哪个地方足够安全。

sentences.en: You're just seeing the options and which is somehow safer for you.
sentences.zh: 你只能看看选项，找一个对你来说相对安全一点的。

sentences.en: And just the whole street is in darkness.
sentences.zh: 整条街道都陷入黑暗。

sentences.en: And I just see people running everywhere to seek shelter at this moment.
sentences.zh: 此刻我只看到人们到处奔跑寻找避难所。

sentences.en: Abdullah, how are you feeling right now?
sentences.zh: 阿卜杜拉，你现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm just feeling terrified about my family.
sentences.zh: 我只是为我的家人感到害怕。

sentences.en: Most of them are children, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们大多数都是孩子。

sentences.en: And I am the biggest one of them.
sentences.zh: 我是他们当中最大的一个。

sentences.en: I'm the biggest brother.
sentences.zh: 我是最大的哥哥。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: I feel the responsibility to make them safe, despite the fact that there is no safe area in the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 尽管加沙地带没有安全区，但我感到有责任让他们安全。

sentences.en: I'm sure you can hear the noise from the neighbors just running.
sentences.zh: 我确信你能听到邻居们奔跑的噪声。

sentences.en: I don't know if you can hear that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你能不能听到。

sentences.en: I hear the voices.
sentences.zh: 我听到声音了。

sentences.en: What is, can you, what's happening downstairs?
sentences.zh: 怎么回事，你能，楼下发生什么了？

sentences.en: Actually, you're just seeing people running at this moment, seeking shelter in another safer place.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你现在看到人们在奔跑，去另一个更安全的地方避难。

sentences.en: That's just away from the building that is threatened to be bombed.
sentences.zh: 那是为了远离面临轰炸威胁的建筑物。

sentences.en: Whole people are just seeking shelter.
sentences.zh: 所有人都在寻找避难所。

sentences.en: I hear them.
sentences.zh: 我听到他们的声音了。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's what's happening at this moment.
sentences.zh: 对，此刻发生的就是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, don't worry, man.
sentences.zh: 好吧，别担心，伙计。

sentences.en: You're going to be bombed.
sentences.zh: 你们要被轰炸了。

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好的，好的。

sentences.en: Okay, okay, Yassin.
sentences.zh: 好的，好的，亚辛。

sentences.en: So actually, my neighbor is telling me to open all the windows and to stay away from them as they are going to bomb soon.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我的邻居告诉我打开所有的窗户，离它们远点，因为他们马上就要轰炸了。

sentences.en: I don't know if you can hear him calling my name or not.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你能听见他叫我的名字还是听不见。

sentences.en: And why was he saying that to you?
sentences.zh: 他为什么对你这么说？

sentences.en: Because when the airstrike happens, if the windows are not open, they will break into your heads.
sentences.zh: 因为空袭发生时，如果不打开窗户，玻璃会碎到你们头上。

sentences.en: So you have to open the windows because the strength of the bombing can break the windows.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须打开窗户，因为轰炸的威力会震碎窗户。

sentences.en: And you have to stay from them not to be injured from the class.
sentences.zh: 你必须远离它们，以免被玻璃碎片伤害。

sentences.en: Do you need to go open the windows right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在需要去开窗户吗？

sentences.en: Actually, we have already done that since the beginning of this escalation against Gaza, because we know what would happen.
sentences.zh: 事实上，针对加沙的这场冲突一开始我们就已经这么做了，因为我们知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: Abdullah, do you have plans to evacuate with your family?
sentences.zh: 阿卜杜拉，你有什么和家人一起撤离的计划吗？

sentences.en: What are you thinking right now in terms of what you want to try to do?
sentences.zh: 关于你想尝试做什么，你现在是怎么想的？

sentences.en: So evacuate where?
sentences.zh: 那么撤离到哪里去？

sentences.en: Where should we go?
sentences.zh: 我们应该去哪里？

sentences.en: Because Gaza, because the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 因为加沙，因为加沙地带。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So let me tell you, in Gaza, we have no shelters.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉你，在加沙，我们没有避难所。

sentences.en: We have no, no safe places.
sentences.zh: 我们没有，没有安全的地方。

sentences.en: Can you hear this?
sentences.zh: 你听到这个了吗？

sentences.en: I can hear it.
sentences.zh: 我听到了。

sentences.en: I can hear it.
sentences.zh: 我听到了。

sentences.en: What are you seeing?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: What is that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: It's a rocket.
sentences.zh: 是一枚火箭弹。

sentences.en: It's a damn airstrike that happens out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 该死的空袭，不知道从哪里冒出来的。

sentences.en: Did it hit something?
sentences.zh: 它击中什么东西了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah, but it's not that close.
sentences.zh: 是的，但离得不是那么近。

sentences.en: I've just seen the red light.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚看到了红光。

sentences.en: And the sound of aircraft is all over the place.
sentences.zh: 到处都是飞机的声音。

sentences.en: The same as the sound of drones that never stop.
sentences.zh: 就像永不停歇的无人机声音一样。

sentences.en: But, yeah, the situation is getting worse by each hour passing.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，随着时间的流逝，情况每小时都在恶化。

sentences.en: So I don't know if I'm going to stay this night and my home or I will leave.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道今晚我是留在家里还是离开。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: It's a prayer.
sentences.zh: 是祈祷声。

sentences.en: That's the call to prayer.
sentences.zh: 那是礼拜的召唤。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Do you need to pray?
sentences.zh: 你需要去祈祷吗？

sentences.en: Are you going to pray?
sentences.zh: 你要去祈祷吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to pray after we are done with this call.
sentences.zh: 我们打完这通电话后我就去祈祷。

sentences.en: What will you pray?
sentences.zh: 你要祈祷什么？

sentences.en: What is your prayer?
sentences.zh: 你的祈祷是什么？

sentences.en: It's kind of a spiritual connection between us and God.
sentences.zh: 这是我们与上帝之间的一种精神联系。

sentences.en: And actually, that's the only thing that helps us at this moment.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是目前唯一能帮助我们的事情。

sentences.en: As we are left, I believe that the people of Gaza are left alone.
sentences.zh: 在我们被抛弃之后，我相信加沙人民被孤立了。

sentences.en: I'll pray for my people to get what they want, to live in peace, because we deserve peace.
sentences.zh: 我会为我的人民祈祷，让他们得到他们想要的，生活在和平中，因为我们理应享有和平。

sentences.en: So, Abdullah, I wanted to ask you, we've been talking about all of the airstrikes that have been happening.
sentences.zh: 所以，阿卜杜拉，我想问你，我们一直在谈论一直在发生的那些空袭。

sentences.en: Since last Saturday.
sentences.zh: 自上周六以来。

sentences.en: And, of course, the thing that happened last Saturday as well was this very deadly attack by Hamas on Israel.
sentences.zh: 当然，上周六发生的事情也是哈马斯对以色列发动的这起极其致命的袭击。

sentences.en: How do you understand that attack?
sentences.zh: 你是如何看待那场袭击的？

sentences.en: Jack, what did you think of that?
sentences.zh: 杰克，你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, it did not start actually by Hamas attack.
sentences.zh: 所以，它其实并不是由哈马斯的袭击开始的。

sentences.en: Because we've been under siege for more than 70 years.
sentences.zh: 因为我们已经被围困了70多年。

sentences.en: And you cannot just put people into prison, deprive them from their fundamental rights, and then see nothing in response.
sentences.zh: 你不能把人们关进监狱，剥夺他们的基本权利，然后却指望没有任何回应。

sentences.en: You cannot dehumanize people and expect nothing.
sentences.zh: 你不能去剥夺人们的人性，却指望什么都不发生。

sentences.en: What do you think about Hamas, Abdullah?
sentences.zh: 阿卜杜拉，你对哈马斯怎么看？

sentences.en: What it is?
sentences.zh: 它是什么？

sentences.en: What it does?
sentences.zh: 它做了什么？

sentences.en: Like, I am not Hamas.
sentences.zh: 比如说，我不是哈马斯。

sentences.en: And I was never a big fan of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 我也从来不是哈马斯的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: We both are different in the ideology.
sentences.zh: 我们两个人的意识形态不同。

sentences.en: But what's happening here is not about Hamas at all.
sentences.zh: 但这里发生的事情根本与哈马斯无关。

sentences.en: What's it about?
sentences.zh: 那跟什么有关？

sentences.en: It's about ethnically cleansing of Palestinian people.
sentences.zh: 这是关于对巴勒斯坦人民的种族清洗。

sentences.en: It's about 2.3 million of Palestinian people.
sentences.zh: 这是关于230万巴勒斯坦人民的事。

sentences.en: That's why Israel, the first thing that it did was cutting off water and cutting off electricity and cutting off food.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么以色列做的第一件事就是切断水、切断电、切断食物。

sentences.en: So, this is not, never about Hamas.
sentences.zh: 所以，这绝不是关于哈马斯的事。

sentences.en: It's about our mistake to be foreign Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 这是关于我们生为巴勒斯坦人的“错误”。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Thank you for talking to us, Abdullah.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你跟我们交谈，阿卜杜拉。

sentences.en: And I wonder if I can call you back tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我想知道明天我能不能再给你打电话。

sentences.en: I want to keep in touch and make sure you're okay.
sentences.zh: 我想保持联系，确保你平安无事。

sentences.en: And if you can, send me a voice memo, okay?
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，发给我一条语音备忘录，好吗？

sentences.en: You hear something in the night, you send a voice memo.
sentences.zh: 如果你在夜里听到什么声音，就发一条语音备忘录。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We start with breaking news on the Israel-Gaza war.
sentences.zh: 我们从关于以色列-加沙战争的突发新闻开始。

sentences.en: Last night, Israel told more than a million Palestinians in northern Gaza to move south, signaling a ground assault is likely coming.
sentences.zh: 昨晚，以色列命令加沙北部的一百多万巴勒斯坦人向南迁移，这表明地面进攻可能即将到来。

sentences.en: And even if those people are able to move south, there is currently no way out of Gaza because the border crossing into Egypt is blocked.
sentences.zh: 即使这些人能够向南迁移，目前也没有离开加沙的出路，因为通往埃及的边境口岸被封锁了。

sentences.en: The
sentences.zh: 这

sentences.en: order to evacuate the north of Gaza to the south of Gaza is just crazy and it got to be a joke because Israel wants to expel more Palestinians from their homes within 24 hours than it did during the whole Nakba of 1948.
sentences.zh: 把加沙北部的人撤离到加沙南部的命令简直太疯狂了，一定是个笑话，因为以色列想在24小时内把比1948年整个灾难日期间还要多的巴勒斯坦人驱逐出他们的家园。

sentences.en: You are talking about more than 1.1 million of Palestinian people that have to evacuate within one day, within 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 你在说的是有一百多万巴勒斯坦人必须在一天之内、在24小时内撤离。

sentences.en: Like, are you serious?
sentences.zh: 拜托，你们是认真的吗？

sentences.en: It's got to be a joke.
sentences.zh: 这一定是个笑话。

sentences.en: Those are really human beings.
sentences.zh: 这些人真的是人类。

sentences.en: These are not just numbers.
sentences.zh: 这些不仅仅是数字。

sentences.en: We are talking about human beings.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是活生生的人。

sentences.en: This has to stop.
sentences.zh: 这必须停止。

sentences.en: The collective punishment that we are facing every minute has to stop.
sentences.zh: 我们每分每秒都在面临的集体惩罚必须停止。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Abdullah.
sentences.zh: 阿卜杜拉。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Hi, Sabine.
sentences.zh: 嗨，萨宾。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 近来可好？

sentences.en: Not good at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不好。

sentences.en: What's happening?
sentences.zh: 怎么了？

sentences.en: I'm just so devastated by the news I'm reading.
sentences.zh: 我看到那些新闻，整个人心碎极了。

sentences.en: Abdulla, it's Friday night at about 9.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 阿卜杜拉，现在是周五晚上九点半左右。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: What are you going to be doing tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚打算做点什么？

sentences.en: What's the next couple of hours look like for you?
sentences.zh: 接下来的几个小时你打算怎么过？

sentences.en: So actually we have my aunt and my cousins coming to our home because they are evacuating as well.
sentences.zh: 实际上我姑妈和表亲们要来我家，因为他们也在疏散。

sentences.en: So I will be spending the night with them.
sentences.zh: 所以我今晚会和他们一起过。

sentences.en: Actually, during escalations, this is something that most of people in Gaza do.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在局势升级的时候，加沙大多数人都会这么做。

sentences.en: They all gather in one room and they stay together all the night.
sentences.zh: 大家都会聚在一个房间里，整夜待在一起。

sentences.en: Or they sleep together in case that their building is to bomb that they will die together.
sentences.zh: 或者挤在一起睡觉，万一他们的楼被炸了，也能死在一起。

sentences.en: So that they die together.
sentences.zh: 这样就能死在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So tonight you'll sleep with your family together.
sentences.zh: 所以今晚你要和家人待在一起睡觉。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's it.
sentences.zh: 对，就是这样。

sentences.en: That's what we do.
sentences.zh: 我们都是这样的。

sentences.en: Somehow it consoles you that you have some company.
sentences.zh: 不知怎的，有伴儿能让你多少得到一点安慰。

sentences.en: It sounds very dark, Abdullah.
sentences.zh: 听起来真残酷，阿卜杜拉。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's it.
sentences.zh: 对，就是这样。

sentences.en: That's the situation here.
sentences.zh: 这里的现状就是如此。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.

sentences.zh: 我叫瓦法·阿尔萨卡，来自佛罗里达州。

sentences.zh: 直到今年3月我還是一名老师。

sentences.zh: 我曾是哈茨菲尔德小学的艺术老师，我住在佛罗里达州塔拉哈西。

sentences.zh: 我在星期六与瓦法·阿尔萨卡进行了交谈。

sentences.en: She's a Palestinian American and she's one of the hundreds of thousands of people who've evacuated from the north of Gaza to the south over the last two days.
sentences.zh: 她是一名巴勒斯坦裔美国人，也是过去两天里从加沙北部疏散到南部的数十万人之一。

sentences.en: I came to visit my family because I have my mother-in-law who's really old.
sentences.zh: 我来探望家人，因为我有一个年事已高的婆婆。

sentences.en: She's a 97-year-old, found it to bed, came to visit her and take care of her.
sentences.zh: 她97岁了，卧床不起，我来是来看望她并照顾她的。

sentences.en: And I have a father who is really ill and sick on oxygen 24-7.
sentences.zh: 我还有一个重病在身的父亲，7天24小时都需要吸氧。

sentences.en: And I just wanted to spend some time with them before, you know, don't know when I'll see them again.
sentences.zh: 我只是想在他们身边多待一会儿，你知道的，因为不知道什么时候才能再见到他们。

sentences.en: And this has happened.
sentences.zh: 结果就发生了这种事。

sentences.en: And now, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不知道该怎么办了。

sentences.en: I was almost struck by a missile yesterday morning.
sentences.zh: 昨天早上我差点被导弹击中。

sentences.en: I promised my sister I'll take care of her mom.
sentences.zh: 我答应过我妹妹我会照顾她妈妈。

sentences.en: And while I was giving her the medicine on the bed, I saw a missile just passing by next to the room, hit the land right across from their house.
sentences.zh: 就在我给床上的她喂药时，我看到一枚导弹擦着房间掠过，击中了他们房子正对面的一片空地。

sentences.en: Everything was collapsing, like, you know, the windows, glass everywhere.
sentences.zh: 一切都在坍塌，你知道的，窗户碎了，到处都是玻璃。

sentences.en: So I threw myself on my mother-in-law to cover her from the debris because I was scared that she could get hit in the eye, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以我扑到婆婆身上替她挡住瓦砾，因为我害怕她的眼睛受伤，你知道的。

sentences.en: Where were you, Wafa?
sentences.zh: 瓦法，你当时在哪里？

sentences.en: Wafa, on Friday night, the Israeli military gave the order for everybody in northern Gaza to evacuate to the south.
sentences.zh: 瓦法，周五晚上，以色列军方下令让加沙北部所有人都疏散到南部。

sentences.en: Did you get that order?
sentences.zh: 你收到这个命令了吗？

sentences.en: No, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 没有，我没收到。

sentences.en: I heard it from my niece.
sentences.zh: 我是从我侄女那里听说的。

sentences.en: And I'm like, no, this is just lying.
sentences.zh: 当时我还想，不可能，这绝对是谎言。

sentences.en: This is propaganda.
sentences.zh: 这是宣传战。

sentences.en: So in my mind, I kept on trying to convince, you know, my sister-in-law and her daughter, no, this is not true.
sentences.zh: 所以在我脑海里，我一直在试图说服我小姑子和她的女儿，不，这不是真的。

sentences.en: And then she gets on her phone that whatever the general of defense from Israel is saying, clear it or else.
sentences.zh: 然后她看着手机，上面说以色列国防将领发出警告，要么撤离，要么后果自负。

sentences.en: And she, from previous wars that she seen, she said, if he says something, he'll do it.
sentences.zh: 根据她从以往战争中看到的经验，她说，只要他说得出，就做得到。

sentences.en: So they start, like, frantically picking up stuff out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始手忙脚乱地到处收拾东西。

sentences.en: Water, food, this, that.
sentences.zh: 水、食物，还有这个那个。

sentences.en: And it's like, we have to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 大家都说，我们必须疏散。

sentences.en: We have to go.
sentences.zh: 我们得走了。

sentences.en: We have to go.
sentences.zh: 我们必须离开。

sentences.en: So everybody, it went, like, at 6 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 所以所有人，大约在6点钟就开始了。

sentences.en: It went, like, no, even 5.30.
sentences.zh: 不，甚至在5点30分就开始了。

sentences.en: They start picking up all the water because we bought a lot of water because there is no water in the city.
sentences.zh: 他们开始抢购所有的水，因为我们买了很多水，而城里已经没有水了。

sentences.en: Like, when you open the faucets, there is no water.
sentences.zh: 比如，你打开水龙头，里面一滴水也没有。

sentences.en: And then we got food, like, of cheeses, and we got tons of bread from the bakery.
sentences.zh: 然后我们弄到了食物，比如奶酪，我们还从面包店买了好几吨面包。

sentences.en: It was a panic, a mode.
sentences.zh: 当时陷入了一片恐慌之中。

sentences.en: And they said, wait until the daytime comes, because if the Israelis see that there is movement down the stairs and near the cars, they might hit us with a missile.
sentences.zh: 他们说，等到天亮再走，因为如果以色列人看到楼梯和汽车附近有人走动，可能会用导弹袭击我们。

sentences.en: And I'm like, this is bullshit.
sentences.zh: 我说，这简直是胡扯。

sentences.en: No, don't say that.
sentences.zh: 不，别这么说。

sentences.en: No, I'm going to go take the stuff and load them in the car for you guys.
sentences.zh: 不，我要去把东西拿来，帮你们搬到车上。

sentences.en: And she goes, no, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 她却说，不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: And she held me back and was like, please, please don't go down.
sentences.zh: 她拉住我哀求道，求求你，求求你别下去。

sentences.en: They will kill you.
sentences.zh: 他们会杀了你的。

sentences.en: They will hit a missile on you.
sentences.zh: 他们会用导弹炸你的。

sentences.en: So your sister-in-law was worried that if you went downstairs and brought the food and supplies to the car, you could get hit with something from the Israeli side.
sentences.zh: 所以你小姑子担心，如果你下楼把食物和物资搬到车上，可能会遭到以色列方面的袭击？

sentences.en: Yes, because they will see movement.
sentences.zh: 对，因为他们会看到有人走动。

sentences.en: And then I was panicking, and I said, I can't do panic because I need to wait and think.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始惊慌失措，我说，我不能慌，我得等下来思考。

sentences.en: I'm not going to go with them.
sentences.zh: 我不打算跟他们一起走。

sentences.en: The embassy already assured me evacuation very soon.
sentences.zh: 大使馆已经向我保证很快就会安排撤离。

sentences.en: And then they said, no, you have to come with us.
sentences.zh: 然后他们说，不，你必须跟我们一起走。

sentences.en: I said, no, I'm not going to go.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，我不走。

sentences.en: This is not safe.
sentences.zh: 这不安全。

sentences.en: What are you guys doing?
sentences.zh: 你们到底在干什么？

sentences.en: So, Wafa, then what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么，瓦法，后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: Did you go with your relatives?
sentences.zh: 你跟亲戚们一起走了吗？

sentences.en: What did you do?
sentences.zh: 你做了什么？

sentences.en: No, they already left.
sentences.zh: 没有，他们已经走了。

sentences.en: So after like about two hours, that missile hit.
sentences.zh: 所以在大约两个小时后，那枚导弹就打过来了。

sentences.en: And it was just right across the street.
sentences.zh: 它就落在街对面。

sentences.en: It was just within a couple of feet of the house.
sentences.zh: 离房子只有几英尺远。

sentences.en: It was like a huge sound with a fire coming next to the window.
sentences.zh: 那声音巨大无比，窗户旁边还腾起了一团火光。

sentences.en: The sound is unbearable.
sentences.zh: 那种声音简直无法忍受。

sentences.en: Like if you ever heard the worst thunder ever, but it's multiplied by hundreds of times of that sound.
sentences.zh: 就像你听过最可怕的雷声，但声音放大了几百倍。

sentences.en: Like it will make you death.
sentences.zh: 声音大得能把人震聋。

sentences.en: And then all debris is all around me, and like dust and gas.
sentences.zh: 然后我周围全是废墟，到处都是灰尘和毒气。

sentences.en: There was a smelly smell.
sentences.zh: 有一股难闻的气味。

sentences.en: I can't describe the smell yet, but it burned the throat and my nose and my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我现在还无法形容那种气味，但它灼烧着我的喉咙、鼻子和眼睛。

sentences.en: And then my brother-in-law called the neighbor next to us, and we took my mother-in-law down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 接着我小叔子打电话叫了隔壁的邻居，我们把婆婆扶下了楼。

sentences.en: And we got my nephew to come back with the car and evacuate us.

sentences.en: I'm telling you, people were hanging out.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说，人们都挂在车外面。

sentences.zh: 有的人打开后备箱，让小孩子们坐在开着盖的后备箱里。

sentences.en: I lost that in English.

sentences.en: You know, the one moves the rubble?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是那种清理瓦砾的机器？

sentences.en: Like a bulldozer?
sentences.zh: 像推土机吗？

sentences.en: Like a digger?
sentences.zh: 像挖掘机？

sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So kids were actually hanging on from the outside of cars, hanging on to people from the inside of the car.
sentences.zh: 所以孩子们实际上是挂在汽车外面，或者抓着车里的人。

sentences.zh: 后备箱都开着。

sentences.zh: 我向你保证，千真万确。

sentences.en: My heart was aching.
sentences.zh: 我的心在作痛。

sentences.en: I felt like my heart is broken to see my city.
sentences.zh: 看到我的城市变成这样，我感觉心都要碎了。

sentences.en: This is unreal.
sentences.zh: 这太不真实了。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I'm not so aware.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点神志不清。

sentences.en: What's that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.zh: 房子上方有一道红光。

sentences.en: We don't know where it is.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道它在哪里。

sentences.en: It went like a sun shined, and then it dropped.
sentences.zh: 它就像太阳一样闪了一下，然后就坠落了。

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: There was a missile hit close by, but it felt like it was in here, but I could see like a sun coming over and then went down.
sentences.zh: 附近有导弹落下，感觉就像砸在我们这里一样，但我能看到像太阳一样的东西飞过来然后沉了下去。

sentences.en: Wafa, you were on the road.
sentences.zh: 瓦法，你当时在路上。

sentences.zh: 你到了汗尤尼斯之后发生了什么？

sentences.zh: 你在那里认识什么人可以去他们家吗？

sentences.zh: 后来怎么了？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不认识。

sentences.en: I've never been to this house before, but my husband's niece, it's the uncle of her husband, you know?
sentences.zh: 我以前从未去过这个房子，但这是我丈夫侄女的丈夫的叔叔，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So it's like a faraway relationship.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种很远的关系。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 我以前没见过他们。

sentences.en: So we call them.
sentences.zh: 所以我们才联系他们。

sentences.zh: 那是又一道阳光照过来。

sentences.en: And there is another one.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个。

sentences.en: And the smell, I can't describe the smell.
sentences.zh: 还有那股气味，我无法形容那种气味。

sentences.en: It's like, you know, like it matches, but very strong, like very strong comes to your throat.
sentences.zh: 就像是，你知道的，就像是火柴味，但非常浓烈，非常刺鼻地冲向你的喉咙。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's like it burns the back of your throat, that sulfur taste.
sentences.zh: 就像灼烧着你的喉咙后方，那种硫磺的味道。

sentences.en: And your eyes and the nose.
sentences.zh: 还有你的眼睛和鼻子。

sentences.en: Does the house shake?
sentences.zh: 房子会晃动吗？

sentences.en: What does it feel like?
sentences.zh: 感觉是怎样的？

sentences.en: Yes, like it's a little earthquakey.
sentences.zh: 是的，感觉有点像地震。

sentences.en: A little earthquake.
sentences.zh: 小地震。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wafa, so you came to this house where you've never been before.
sentences.zh: 瓦法，所以你来到了这个你从未去过的房子。

sentences.en: Have you met the owners?
sentences.zh: 你见过房主吗？

sentences.en: Are they feeding you what's happening in the house?
sentences.zh: 他们有跟你说屋里发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: We brought in lots of food and they have some too.
sentences.zh: 我们带了很多食物，他们自己也有一些。

sentences.en: But then you don't feel like eating when you see in all this pain, you know, but we have kids and we have to feed them and they're still crying all day long.
sentences.zh: 但当你看到这一切痛苦时，你根本没有心情吃东西，你知道的，但我们有孩子，我们得喂饱他们，而且他们整天都在哭。

sentences.en: They're crying.
sentences.zh: 他们在哭。

sentences.en: They're been asking their parents, they want to go home.
sentences.zh: 他们在问父母，他们想回家。

sentences.en: They are tired of this.
sentences.zh: 他们厌倦了这一切。

sentences.en: How many kids are you with?
sentences.zh: 你和多少个孩子在一起？

sentences.en: We have about 10, 10 little kids.
sentences.zh: 我们大概有10个，10个小孩子。

sentences.en: But we have about 70 people on here.
sentences.zh: 但这里大约有70人。

sentences.en: Don't hear me.
sentences.zh: 听不见我说话。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天呐。

sentences.en: Another one.
sentences.zh: 又一个。

sentences.en: Another one.
sentences.zh: 又一个。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 所以发生了什么？

sentences.en: You arrived to the house.
sentences.zh: 你到达了那个房子。

sentences.en: You're staying with...
sentences.zh: 你和……住在一起。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I came in here.
sentences.zh: 我来到这里。

sentences.en: I stayed.
sentences.zh: 我住了下来。

sentences.en: And then I felt uncomfortable since I don't know them.
sentences.zh: 然后我感到很不自在，因为我不认识他们。

sentences.en: So I called a friend of mine and she has her cousin lives in Han Yunis.
sentences.zh: 所以我给我的一个朋友打了电话，她有个表亲住在汗尤尼斯。

sentences.en: So I went there with them, which was yesterday, Friday.
sentences.zh: 所以我跟他们一起去了那里，那是昨天，星期五。

sentences.en: We ate, you know, little sandwiches of cheese and za'atar and a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 我们吃了，你知道的，一点奶酪和百里香碎的小三明治，还有一杯茶。

sentences.en: And then I said, I haven't slept for a week.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，我一个星期没睡觉了。

sentences.en: So they gave me a mattress on one of the rooms and I slept.
sentences.zh: 于是他们在其中一个房间给我铺了张床垫，我睡着了。

sentences.en: I actually went into a deep sleep and 5.15 almoSt.
sentences.zh: 我其实陷入了沉睡，将近5点15分。

sentences.en: A huge, earthquakey sound with things coming through the window and then screams of these young little girls coming out of their mattresses like popcorn, freaking out.
sentences.zh: 一声巨大的、地震般的巨响，东西穿窗而入，然后这些年轻的小女孩们的尖叫声响起，她们像爆米花一样从床垫上弹起来，吓得魂飞魄散。

sentences.en: What the hell is this?
sentences.zh: 这到底是什么鬼？

sentences.en: Did I go to hell or something?
sentences.zh: 我是下地狱了吗还是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I jumped out and started grabbing those girls who are 15 and 13, freaking out, shaking.
sentences.zh: 我猛地跳起来，开始抓住那些15岁和13岁的女孩，她们吓得魂飞魄散、浑身发抖。

sentences.en: And I'm like, we're okay.
sentences.zh: 我说，我们没事。

sentences.en: We're okay.
sentences.zh: 我们没事。

sentences.en: We're okay.
